newsitem.title: USA: Concord Camera sees profitable Q2.
newsitem.headline: Concord Camera sees profitable Q2.

text.p: Concord Camera Corp said Monday it expects its second quarter to be profitable and for sales during that period to be ahead of those in the first quarter and possibly ahead of the prior year's second quarter.
However, Concord Chairman and Chief Executive Ira Lampert said in a statement that the company remains "cautious about near-term financial performance."

The company said it expects increased production levels in the second and third quarters, and expects sales of single-use cameras for the first six months will exceed the same period in the prior year.

The company said it also has designed a number of cameras using the Advanced Photographic System technology, and plans to introduce them in the fourth quarter of the 1997 fiscal year and the first half of the 1998 fiscal year.
